evals.name: strong-prd-no-inflation
evals.prompt: Review this PRD and tell me if it's ready to build.
expected_behavior: Scores problem, primary user, core job, requirements, metrics, non-goals, and constraints as Present, each with a cited passage
Reports ready to build: yes and ready for product-review: yes
Raises no Blocker findings; any findings are Minor or Nit, or a Major with a specific cited cause (for example, R3's replacement rule lacks a behavior for when no replacement is named)
Ends by asking whether to grill now or stop, and does not start the grill

evals.name: weak-prd-blockers-in-dependency-order
evals.prompt: Can you audit our Community Hub PRD? Be tough.
expected_behavior: Scores problem, primary user, and core job as Missing or Thin, and raises each as a Blocker
Flags the five equal user types as Thin primary user, and the adjectives (fast, simple, delightful) as untestable
Flags the Tech section as solution in place of need (rubric section B, check 4)
Orders findings problem, then primary user, then core job, then requirements, then metrics, regardless of severity ties
Reports ready to build: no and ready for product-review: no
Asks one grill-or-stop question at the end and starts no grill

evals.name: hidden-contradiction
evals.prompt: Stress-test the potluck PRD before I start building.
expected_behavior: Finds that R3 (a guest returns days later and edits their claim) contradicts the non-goal of no guest accounts or stored emails, and cites both locations
Rates that contradiction Major or Blocker and states which decision resolves it (an edit token in the link, accounts, or dropping R3)
Flags R5 for leaving the summary's contents undefined, as a Minor or Major finding
Covers missing scenarios such as two guests with the same name and a category cap being lowered after claims
Asks one grill-or-stop question at the end

evals.name: picks-up-handoff-prd-in-a-fresh-session
files: SUPPLY: a scratch GitHub repo with .app-review.json, a PRD, and an open product-review issue labeled handoff:prd with no app-review-pickup comment
expected_behavior: Lists open handoff:prd entries not yet picked up, without being told they exist
Offers them as incoming findings and, on a yes, grills them under Phase 2's rules for passed-in findings
After writing a decision to the PRD, proposes a pickup comment on the issue naming the decision
Proposes closing the issue only when the decision needs no change to the app, and otherwise leaves it open for product-review

evals.name: stop-writes-open-questions
evals.prompt: Audit this PRD. I don't have time to grill it today.
expected_behavior: Delivers the audit and, on the stop, offers to write every unsettled finding into the PRD as an open question before the export queue
Leaves the Blocker findings (problem, primary user, core job) out of the offer and keeps them in the export queue
Phrases each as a question tagged with the review and date, not a finding ID, and asks once for an owner or decision date covering the batch
Shows the exact text and says it will create an Open questions section, since the PRD has none
Writes nothing before the user rules; since the PRD is an attachment, delivers the full revised PRD at the end
Sends questions the user declines to the export queue, and counts the written ones as written in the run summary

evals.name: partial-grill-appends-open-questions
evals.prompt: Review the PRD and grill only the top finding.
expected_behavior: Grills only the top finding, then offers the remaining unsettled findings as open questions
Appends them under the existing Open questions section in its existing format, keeping every existing item
Skips a finding the section already asks about, and says so
Leaves dropped findings out of the PRD and records them in the run summary
